source_basis: V12 development observations: correct values lost final precision; bulky source selectors caused retries.

skill.title: share_difference
skill.guidance: For two categories sharing one total: (first-second)/total. A decimal answer keeps that fraction; percent multiplies by 100 once. Do not confuse this with relative growth over the second category.

skill.title: decimal_scale
skill.guidance: A decimal ratio is the fraction, not the percentage number: 25%=0.25. Preserve the unrounded fraction; round only after the requested scale is fixed.

skill.title: polynomial_fit
skill.goal: Complete source series before polynomial forecasting
skill.guidance: Fit only the specified observations with an intercept; keep the target actual outside the fit. Use all required months. A polynomial of degree d needs at least d+1 distinct x values.

skill.title: difference_value
skill.guidance: Subtract matching categories and units: signed change is new minus old; absolute difference takes abs only when requested.

skill.title: rolling_range
skill.goal: Rolling statistic over the full requested scope
skill.guidance: Keep months in order and years in separate groups. Compute each full rolling window, then pooled max minus min across the requested groups. Do not report a min-to-max interval.

skill.title: normalized_midpoint
skill.guidance: Midpoint-normalized difference is abs(b-a)/((abs(a)+abs(b))/2). Keep the decimal fraction unless a percent conversion is explicitly requested.

skill.title: compound_growth
skill.goal: Source-bound compound growth and final percent display
skill.guidance: CAGR=(end/start)^(1/elapsed_years)-1. Count intervals, not rows. Percent per year means multiply by 100 once and display %; do not round endpoints.

skill.title: annual_log
skill.guidance: Continuous relative change is ln(end/start). Divide by elapsed years only for an annualized rate; otherwise use one interval. It is not an absolute currency difference.

skill.title: absolute_deviation
skill.goal: Absolute deviation from the stated benchmark
skill.guidance: Average absolute deviation from a benchmark is mean(abs(value-benchmark)); retain all requested dates. Percentage-point inputs stay at that magnitude; a unit of measure need not be a suffix.

skill.title: dispersion
skill.goal: Select the statistical population before calculation
skill.guidance: For all stated years use population divisor n. Use n-1 only for an explicitly requested sample estimate. Do not change the convention after computing.

skill.title: regression_coordinates
skill.goal: Source-bound linear fit and signed forecast error
skill.guidance: Fit the requested years only, in the stated t coordinates. Keep forecast_x and its actual value outside fitting periods. Preserve the requested forecast-minus-actual sign.

skill.title: paired_series
skill.guidance: Pair both observed series by the same period and adjustment basis. Do not fill a missing external series from memory. A correlation needs both actual series.

skill.title: series_scope
skill.goal: Mean over exactly the requested periods
skill.guidance: Use exactly the requested periods and category for a mean. Preserve blank columns; exclude adjacent totals, duplicated months and forecast observations.

skill.title: log_trim
skill.guidance: Apply the requested logarithm first, sort, remove floor(n*proportion) values per tail, then average the retained values. Take the total column, not a financing component.

skill.title: median_deviation
skill.guidance: Compute the median of the complete selected series, then average absolute distances from that median. Verify revisions before fixing the series.

skill.title: theil
skill.guidance: For positive observations, Theil T is mean((x/mean(x))*ln(x/mean(x))). Round the computed result normally; do not truncate to fit an expected-looking value.

skill.title: revision_basis
skill.goal: Choose the matching revision before binding cells
skill.guidance: For an overlapping historical observation, compare later retrospective tables before choosing the value. Honor an explicit as-of release first; otherwise use the latest same-definition revision.

skill.title: total_scope
skill.guidance: A total may be in the continued panel; do not substitute its largest component. Reporting in dollars does not restrict a category to dollar-denominated assets.

skill.title: table_groups
skill.guidance: Count blank cells as columns. Read the full year/category header above a repeated month. Bind the exact row in that group, not the first matching month elsewhere.

skill.title: final_precision
skill.goal: Preserve the requested numeric display at submission
skill.guidance: Honor an explicit output template first. Keep exactly n decimal digits, including trailing zeros; nearest tenth/hundredth/thousandth means 1/2/3 digits. Percentage points and per-year units set the scale, not a word suffix. For percentages preserve the requested % or bare-number form. Do not simplify a correctly formatted computed string or append unrequested words.

entry_constraints.description: Caller explicitly declares source and output scales

program.title: Submit an acquired final scalar with explicit scale and exact decimal display

implementation.goal: Preserve the requested numeric display at submission

profiles.rules: Frozen V12 short-rule control, native tools only
profiles.precise: Same short rules plus final numeric-display atom, including finish-only
profiles.display: Precise plus one scalar finalizer after an acquired numeric result exists
